product_overview: TaskFlow is a responsive web-based task tracking application that lets users register, log in, and manage their own tasks through creation, editing, filtering, and status updates. Administrators also get organization-wide visibility into tasks and user roles through dedicated admin consoles.
core_goals: Create and manage personal tasks throughout their lifecycle
Filter and search tasks to quickly find relevant work
Update task status efficiently without editing full task details
Inspect task details in a dedicated view
For administrators, review organization-wide tasks and manage user roles

features.name: User Authentication & Registration
features.description: Allows new users to create an account and returning users to log in with secure password handling and validation.
user_flows: Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=login -> Toggle to account creation -> Fill in full name, email, and password -> Observe password strength validation -> Submit the registration form -> See a successful account creation message
Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=login -> Toggle to login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the task dashboard

features.name: Task Management (CRUD)
features.description: Lets authenticated users create, inspect, update, and delete their own tasks from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=dashboard -> Open task creation -> Enter a required title and optional description -> Choose status, priority, and due date -> Submit the task form -> See the new task appear in the list
Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=dashboard -> Open a task for inspection -> Review the full task details -> Close the inspection view
Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=dashboard -> Open task editing -> Modify the task details -> Submit the changes -> See the task updated in the list
Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=dashboard -> Start deleting a task -> Confirm deletion -> See the task removed from the list

Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=dashboard -> Open task creation -> Enter an empty or overlong title -> Observe validation feedback -> Correct the input -> Submit the task form -> See the task saved

features.name: Quick Status Update
features.description: Provides a fast way to change a task’s status without opening the full edit form.
user_flows: Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=dashboard -> Open the status change control for a task -> Select a new status -> Confirm the change -> See the task move and highlight according to its new status
Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=dashboard -> Mark a task as completed from the quick action control -> Confirm the change -> See completed tasks repositioned to the bottom of the list

features.name: Search and Filter
features.description: Helps users narrow the dashboard task list by searching titles and filtering by status.
user_flows: Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=dashboard -> Type a search term -> Apply the search -> See matching tasks in the list
Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=dashboard -> Select a status filter from a summary metric card -> See the task list update to that status
Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=dashboard -> Apply a status filter -> Combine it with a search term -> View the filtered task results

features.name: Administrator User & Task Management
features.description: Gives administrators access to all organization tasks and user management tools, including role changes and per-user task breakdowns.
user_flows: Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=admin-tasks -> Review the system tasks console -> Search or filter tasks -> Inspect a task from the organization-wide list -> See its detailed information
Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=admin-users -> Review the user directory -> Open a user’s task breakdown -> See that user’s full task list and workload metrics
Navigate to /task-tracker/public/index.php?page=admin-users -> Review the user directory -> Change a user’s role -> See the updated role reflected in the directory

routes.description: Authentication page supporting toggleable User Login and User Registration
User Task Workspace Dashboard with metrics, search, status filtering, task CRUD, quick status update, and task inspection
Administrator System Tasks Console displaying all organization tasks across users with search, status filters, and admin task inspection
Administrator User Directory and Access Control with role promotion/demotion and interactive user task details view

features.name: User Authentication & Registration
features.description: Secure registration and login with bcrypt password hashing and strength rules
user_interactions: Toggle between Login and Create Account tabs
Fill full name, email, and password
See password strength indicator validation in real-time
Submit form with CSRF token protection
View friendly error or success flash alerts

features.name: Task Management (CRUD)
features.description: Create, read, update, and delete tasks with strict user isolation and validation
user_interactions: Click Add Task button to open creation modal
Fill task title (required, max 150 chars) and description
Select status and priority
Select task deadline (restricted to today or future dates)
Submit task to save or update
Click task card to view detailed task inspection popup
Click edit icon to open prefilled edit modal
Click delete icon to confirm and delete task

features.name: Quick Status Update
features.description: Fast one-click status transition without editing entire task details
user_interactions: Click 'Mark as Completed' or 'Change status' chip beside task
Select target status (Pending, In Progress, Completed)
Confirm status change
View updated list with completed tasks repositioned and highlighted

features.name: Search and Filter
features.description: Real-time search by title and filter by status
user_interactions: Click summary metric cards (In Progress, Completed, Pending) to filter tasks immediately
Type search query in search input
Click Filter button
View paginated task list results

features.name: Administrator User & Task Management
features.description: Manage global system tasks and configure user roles
user_interactions: View all users and their workload metrics
Click on any user row to view that user's full task breakdown modal
Click Change Role button to toggle between Admin and User
View global tasks across all users in System Tasks console
